title: Corn Cacio y Pepe
description: A summer flavored corn forward cacio y Pepe inspired dish. Goes great over pasta. Could also work as a dip.
searchText: Corn Cacio y Pepe A summer flavored corn forward cacio y Pepe inspired dish. Goes great over pasta. Could also work as a dip. Sauces & Condiments Corn pepper summer 320g corn or ~3 ears 15g peppercorns 60g water Salt 625g Pasta, fettuccini works best ~125g Parmesan , freshly grated 15-30g butter, taste depending

title: David’s Oven-Reduced Tomato Sauce
description: A deep, long-cooked tomato sauce built on onion, carrot, celery, garlic, toasted tomato paste, red wine, and Parmesan, then slowly reduced in the oven.
searchText: David’s Oven-Reduced Tomato Sauce A deep, long-cooked tomato sauce built on onion, carrot, celery, garlic, toasted tomato paste, red wine, and Parmesan, then slowly reduced in the oven. Sauces & Condiments tomato pasta sauce oven reduced batch cooking 10.9 kg crushed tomatoes 800 g tomato paste 6 onions about 900 g 450 g carrots 450 g celery 25–30 g garlic 1 cup red wine Parmesan herbs seasonings

title: Hot Elote Dip
description: A lighter hot elote-style corn dip built around deeply charred corn and a strained corn purée, with cotija, lime, garlic, and smoky chile instead of a heavy mayo base.
searchText: Hot Elote Dip A lighter hot elote-style corn dip built around deeply charred corn and a strained corn purée, with cotija, lime, garlic, and smoky chile instead of a heavy mayo base.
